verdict.rationale: Natural language is Instinct's primary interface: the vendor says there are no new interfaces and you simply text or call it, and access can even be revoked by conversation (instinct-docs-1, instinct-docs-6). Hands-on reviewers confirm that plain iMessage requests produce real actions, with confirmations in the same chat: phone calls, pizza orders, travel and email follow-ups (instinct-comm-9, instinct-comm-11, instinct-comm-2). Missing for 10: some account and data-management operations (deleting indexed data, opting out of training) are handled in a settings UI rather than by command, and one tester's chat request to delete Gmail records was refused (instinct-docs-12, instinct-docs-14, instinct-comm-3).
